notes.title: After Day One...
notes.content:
Admittedly, day one didn't go as smoothly as planned and multiple game breaking bugs were discovered, and we would like to thank you for sticking through the multiple patches pushed out yesterday.

Now those have been sorted as of the most recent patch, it's time to look ahead and for us to produce more content for the game. Over the coming weeks there will be many content updates adding things both that are already planned, and those that the community suggest.

Despite the poor reviews we've been getting, it doesn't change the fact that the game will be supported and fixed well into the future to mould it into what it should have been at launch. (You can support us by leaving a good review :3)

Thanks to all of you who have made a purchase, or who have joined the discord community and have given suggestions!

It can only get better from this point!

[b]Discord:[/b] https://discord.gg/sJ9pmKV

[b]Download the game for free!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/884090/Idle_Dungeons/[/b]

Thanks for your interest and continued support.

notes.title: Release!
notes.content:
It's finally here! After many delays and renditions of the game, it has been released!

Try it out for free! You're not losing out on anything if it's not for you.

As you may know the game has been delayed and re-worked multiple times but that has only meant that the game has gradually got better over time. We apologise and would like to thank those that have been with us on this long journey to release!

We will be posting a road map (soon) of all the future updates that are planned to come out as the game and community grow. These will be things such as:
[list]
[*] Procedurally generated dungeons, so there's a truly infinite world you can explore.
[*] A clan system, so you can compete in leagues to earn rewards and items.
[*] Unique items to equip that give certain bonuses and upgrade the look of your dungeoneer.
[*] Any suggestions you might have can and will be implemented if they fit the game! (Check the discord for where you can post these).
[/list]

We are looking forward to hearing your input on the game and want to try and grow it to be a community led idle game that is something that people will want to continue to play for the foreseeable future.

Join the Discord for all the discussions and for any support that you may need on the game. We're always active and will take into account any suggestions you might have.

[b]Discord:[/b] https://discord.gg/sJ9pmKV

[b]Download the game for free!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/884090/Idle_Dungeons/[/b]

Thanks for your interest and continued support.

notes.title: Progress Report
notes.content:
Sorry for the seeming lack of updates with both the beta and game recently, but behind closed doors the game has been progressing nicely!

We're proud to present one of the newer features recently added to the game: Character Customisation!

This is a new feature and you'll be able to create the adventurer to represent you, as you'll battle your way through waves of enemies and treacherous dungeons!

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=7q8MGux092o

The re-work of the game is coming on nicely and with that said, we're 100% heading for release on schedule this time. The game both looks and plays completely differently to how it did before, and it will now put it apart from our previous game and other games in the idle market too.

If you can't wait to play the game, the beta is always open for more people to come and take a key. Simply look in the #beta-keys section of the discord and you will find a key which you can use to gain access to the beta.

[b]Discord:[/b] https://discord.gg/sJ9pmKV

[b]Be sure to be "following" the game for updates: https://store.steampowered.com/app/884090/Idle_Dungeons/[/b]

Thanks for your patience and continued support.

notes.title: Planned Re-work
notes.content:
Hi, as some of you have noticed, the game has had multiple push backs.

The game has been delayed due to personal reasons and delays within my own life. Being the sole developer, things can unfortunately get in the way. With this also not being my job, or main source of income, sadly it doesn't take top priority.

However, it has now seen a 2 month push back to the new year as I am currently re-working the entire game to implement more RPG style elements and change the look of the game.

In the long run, this will benefit the game to make it more unique, however the downside is this takes extra time.

The new direction of the game is a Diablo inspired dungeon crawler where it feels like you are actually going through the dungeons, and fighting hard battles against a verity of enemies.

If you can't wait to play the game, the beta is always open for more people to come and take a key. Simply look in the [u][b]#beta-keys[/b][/u] section of the discord and you will find a key which you can use to gain access to the beta.

[u][b]Discord:[/b] https://discord.gg/sJ9pmKV[/u]

If you are in the Discord, you will get to see sneak-peaks of the game in progress and gain direct access to where you can help to influence the direction and decisions I make to make the game what it is.


For now, here are a couple of screenshots (some very WIP) to tide you over until the first iteration of the new style comes to beta in a couple of weeks.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32988431/d730f66af37e5912afa7c1bf9c4a482c8b7ccaab.png[/img]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32988431/3ca6ba86ee52de7aebf654ff84be4ef05b9fcccd.png[/img]

Again, the images above show only the very first ideas for what the game will end up being like. I plan to make the game into more of a unique clicker, and not just something that will blend in.

[b]Be sure to be "following" the game for updates: https://store.steampowered.com/app/884090/Idle_Dungeons/[/b]

Thanks for your patience and continued support.
